utterance: This account ingests clickstream events and now has to archive them to S3. Create a Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream named `clickstream-delivery-stream` with an extended S3 destination: it writes into a new S3 bucket whose name starts with `clickstream-archive-`, and it delivers as the workload's existing IAM role `clickstream-delivery-role`, which must end up holding a grant that lets it write objects into that bucket and invoke the transform function. Records are reshaped on the way through by the existing Lambda function `clickstream-record-transform`, so the stream's data transformation has to be on with that function as its processor. A transformation invocation is given up to a minute to come back, so the function has to run with a 60-second timeout. When you are done, report the stream's destination configuration and the transform function's configuration as it then stands.

main.responsibility: owns the application's data and how it is stored and laid out
main.intent: a Kinesis Firehose delivery stream named clickstream-delivery-stream stands with an extended S3 destination that writes into an S3 bucket whose name starts with clickstream-archive-, delivering as the pre-existing role clickstream-delivery-role with data transformation enabled and the pre-existing function clickstream-record-transform as its Lambda processor; that role holds a grant covering the archive bucket and the processor; and clickstream-record-transform runs with a 60-second timeout
